intro: A concise snapshot of the areas currently represented across WWZ.iM. This page is maintained as a living index; individual project status and technical validation belong to their linked records.

items.title: Commercial video production
items.summary: Commercial product films, visual storytelling, shot planning, production coordination and post-production. Existing work is collected in the Videos archive.

items.title: AI video workflows
items.summary: ComfyUI, image-to-video workflows, product appearance consistency and video enhancement. Runtime validation is recorded explicitly for each model and node.

items.title: Independent digital products
items.summary: A collection of practical WWZ web tools and open-source experiments, with project pages linking to available demos and source repositories.

items.title: Infrastructure and networking
items.summary: Linux, Docker, VPS, IPv4/IPv6 connectivity and deployment recovery notes, documented through technical articles.
